name: 金庸群侠传
english_description: A sibling archive to this project's jyqxc (numbers 086/087). A file-by-file diff confirmed the two are, in essence, two near-complete snapshots of the same original data rather than independently developed variants sharing only the same architecture — of roughly 3,690 files in each "work" tree, only a handful differ (a not-yet-patched login script, two runtime logs, and each one's leftover test character), while the death system and other core files are byte-for-byte identical. The archive filenames even show the classic browser double-download pattern, suggesting both came from the same original download that this project's deduplication process didn't catch.
